# outbound_network (Data Source)

Reads a network, for example for its egress IPs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "outbound_network" "main" {
  id = "123456789012_eu-west-1_vpc-0abc123"
}

output "egress_ips" {
  value = data.outbound_network.main.egress_ips
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Composite `<account>_<region>_<vpc-id>`.

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) Display name in the Outbound UI.
- `cloud_account_id` (String) Cloud account that owns the VPC.
- `egress_ips` (List of String) Public IPs of the gateways.
- `gateway_ids` (List of String) Instance IDs of the gateways.
- `generation` (Number) Desired-state generation.
- `instance_type` (String) Gateway instance type.
- `region` (String) Region of the VPC.
- `status` (String) `monitored` or `inactive`.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-locking version.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC.
